graph.summary: Vasopressin → Vasopressin V2 receptor → cAMP-mediated signaling → Weibel-Palade body exocytosis → von Willebrand factor → Coagulation factor VIII → Hemophilia A

evidence.snippet: Its effect on VWF and t-PA as well as its vasodilatory effect are likely explained by a direct action on the endothelium, via activation of endothelial vasopressin V2R receptor and cAMP-mediated signaling.
evidence.explanation: DDAVP (the synthetic vasopressin analogue) activates the endothelial vasopressin V2 receptor (AVPR2), initiating cAMP-mediated signaling.

evidence.snippet: VWF is synthesized in megakaryocytes and endothelial cells, and is stored and secreted from platelet alpha granules and Weibel-Palade bodies of endothelial cells.
evidence.explanation: Weibel-Palade body exocytosis releases stored VWF into plasma, raising circulating VWF levels.

paper.title: Factor VIII Is Synthesized in Human Endothelial Cells, Packaged in Weibel-Palade Bodies and Secreted Bound to ULVWF Strings.

evidence.snippet: DDAVP elicits the release of von Willebrand Factor (VWF) from endothelial cells, thereby increasing the levels of circulating VWF and coagulation factor (F)VIII.

paper.title: Plasma proteomics in patients with von Willebrand disease and hemophilia A highlights von Willebrand factor as main determinant of response to desmopressin treatment.
paper.journal: Research and practice in thrombosis and haemostasis

evidence.snippet: FVIII stability and half-life is dependent on non-covalent complex formation with von Willebrand factor (VWF) to avoid proteolysis and clearance.
evidence.explanation: VWF forms a non-covalent complex with FVIII, stabilizing it against proteolysis and prolonging its half-life in circulation.

paper.title: Factor VIII Is Synthesized in Human Endothelial Cells, Packaged in Weibel-Palade Bodies and Secreted Bound to ULVWF Strings.

evidence.snippet: Owing to its ability to raise plasma levels of factor VIII and von Willebrand factor levels, the synthetic vasopressin analogue desmopressin has become the mainstay of treatment for type 1 von Willebrand disease and mild hemophilia A.
evidence.explanation: Raising plasma factor VIII levels is the mechanism by which desmopressin/vasopressin treats mild hemophilia A.

paper.title: The use of desmopressin in mild hemophilia A.
paper.journal: Blood coagulation & fibrinolysis : an international journal in haemostasis and thrombosis
